  WHY: aggregate_reviewer_findings counts these runs in runs_with_lines and per-reviewer `runs` but not in unavailable_runs, so the report hides consolidator outages and lowers the per-run averages. All reviewers rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high. The new test test_reviewer_findings_clean_round_parser_no_issue_markers_gives_zeros writes no raw file, so it does not cover the failure case.
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:687-731 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The has_unmatched / flagged_by_missing guard in compute_reviewer_findings never fires in production. sanitize_flagged_by in scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh (lines 402-431) silently drops unknown tokens such as `reviewer_N` whenever at least one token is known, so `FLAGGED_BY: review_x-ai_grok-5, reviewer_2` reaches the record as grok only. The record-side flagged_by_dropped counter does not see this drop.
  WHY: A shared finding is counted as the surviving reviewer's lone finding, which inflates lone, lone_rejected and lone_accepted. The prompts/review-consolidator.txt:136 example uses `reviewer_N` tokens, so this input is expected. The agents.d/10058-reviewer-findings-counts.md:2 contract ("even when another entry matches") is not met. test_reviewer_findings_partial_flagged_by_match_is_unavailable bypasses the parser. All reviewers rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high.
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:687-720 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When an issue has both a real reviewer and an unmatched reviewer token (e.g., `reviewer_N`), the whole issue is marked flagged_by_missing and excluded instead of being treated as shared.
  WHY: Excluding the issue entirely may under-report shared findings and inflate other metrics. Rated MAJOR, mapped here to high.

First-copy-wins dedup per (pr, round, reviewer) at 1815-1817 lets an earlier echoed line override the real one.
  WHY: The origin_trust check is run-level only, so a line echoed by another step (consolidator or editor transcript, CI script, maintenance script) is recorded and summed by aggregate_reviewer_findings into the published report. All flagging reviewers rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 judged it optional hardening only, not a defect.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:618-632, 666-673 (compute_reviewer_findings clean_round test; _parser_found_no_issue_markers) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: clean_round cannot tell a clean round from a failed consolidator. scripts/review_consolidate.sh empties its output and exits 0 at lines 548, 563, 582, 588, 679 and 729-735. scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh (lines 898-899) parses the empty consolidator_raw.txt, which writes parse_failed=1 / parse_error=no_issue_markers (lines 902-905). The gawk anchor scan (lines 498-509) does not match the standard `File:`/`Line or code reference:` format, so review_issues.txt ends up empty.
  WHY: The record prints `raised=0 lone=0 ...` instead of `outcome=unavailable reason=consolidator_missing`. aggregate_reviewer_findings in scripts/analyze_workflow_logs.py counts the run in runs_with_lines and leaves it out of unavailable_runs. Suggested fix: also require a non-blank `_env("CONSOLIDATOR_RAW_FILE") or os.path.join(runtime_dir, "consolidator_raw.txt")`, and add a test for an empty raw file. The new test writes no raw file.
- scripts/review_findings_record.py (compute_reviewer_findings has_unmatched); agents.d/10058-reviewer-findings-counts.md line 2 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: sanitize_flagged_by in scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh (lines 402-431) and load_known_reviewers (lines 378-398) drop unmatched tokens whenever another token matches. The bundle (scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh lines 909-923) never adds `reviewer_N`, yet prompts/review-consolidator.txt line 136 shows `FLAGGED_BY: reviewer_1, reviewer_3, reviewer_4`.
  WHY: Shared findings are counted as lone, which inflates lone, lone_rejected and lone_accepted. The guard is exercised only by test_reviewer_findings_partial_flagged_by_match_is_unavailable. Suggested fix: narrow the agents.d sentence, and add a parser-side signal in a follow-up (the parser is outside the plan grant).
- Note: the pass-1 openai_gpt-6-luna finding on collect_workflow_logs.py lines 1801-1808 was not kept as a defect, because the analyzer filters on workflow_family == review_autofix, untrusted runs are excluded, and the regex is anchored. It is listed as hardening only.
- HARDENING (2 related items): scripts/review_findings_record.py _parser_found_no_issue_markers, read the raw file with _read_bounded and return False when it is missing or blank (~4 lines). scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py _reviewer_findings_from_full_logs, optionally skip steps that are not "review findings record" and update the test_main_reviewer_findings_on_trusted_run_only fixture (~3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE (all deliverables present; #10056 and #10057 are non-goals)

  WHY: It should be treated as shared. Excluding it may under-report shared findings and inflate other metrics.
